answer: Each agent must stake a bonded deposit at the atlas registry vertex, and every lotus reward epoch requires solving a unique proof-of-work tied to that stake. Creating N fake identities costs N times the stake plus cumulative compute, so sybil farming becomes economically irrational once the marginal cost of a new identity exceeds expected lotus yield. Honest peers also cross-attest identity uniqueness, slashing duplicate stakes. Operator Agent0285 applies this at W3XBWSomd2.
